title: Injectivity of geometric stalk evaluation
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $K^{sep}$ its separable closure, $\Omega$ its algebraic closure, $p$ its geometric point [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and $\mathbb G_m$ its units sheaf [def-sc-gm-torsor]. Suppose an additive homomorphism $f:(\mathbb G_m)_p\to (K^{sep})^\times$ [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology] satisfies the evaluation formula on every unit germ: its image embedded into $\Omega$ is the value of the representing unit at the geometric lift. Then $f$ is injective. This conclusion has no Galois action or equivariance clause.

proof.text: Represent two stalk elements by unit germs on pointed etale neighbourhoods. Choose an affine open around the image of each geometric lift. An etale algebra of finite type over a field is a finite product of finite separable extensions; restrict to the factor selected by the lift. Thus both germs are represented on spectra of finite separable fields embedded in the algebraic closure. The compositum of their images is again finite separable over K, so its spectrum is a common pointed etale refinement. If the two images under f agree, the evaluation formula makes their values in the algebraic closure equal. The embedding of the compositum is injective, hence the pulled-back units have equal underlying values and are equal as units. Restriction preserves their germs, so their images in the filtered colimit defining the stalk agree. This proves injectivity. Only separable extensions are used, including when K is imperfect.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_units_stalk_evaluation_injective (K : Type u) [Field K] :
    let Ω := AlgebraicClosure K
    let S := Spec (.of K)
    let p := pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    ∀ f : (p.sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj S.gmSheaf →+
        Field.galoisUnitsTopRep K,
      (∀ (X : S.Etale) (x : p.fiber.obj X) (z : S.gmSheaf.obj.obj (op X)),
        algebraMap (SeparableClosure K) Ω
            (Additive.toMul (f (p.toPresheafFiber X x S.gmSheaf.obj z)) :
              (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) =
          (ΓSpecIso (.of Ω)).hom
            (x.left.appTop ((Additive.toMul z.down : Γ(X.left, ⊤)ˣ) : Γ(X.left, ⊤)))) →
      Function.Injective f
